pages.title: What Is a Good HRV? Average HRV Ranges by Age for Adults (WHOOP)
pages.reason: Highest-ranking external article for the primary query (position 2; also position 7 for 'hrv by age'); cited by the AI Overview; answers the exact reader task (is my number good, by-age ranges, personal baseline) with vendor population averages. DR 80, est. 12,835 monthly traffic.

pages.title: Heart rate variability normal range (Kubios)
pages.reason: Second-highest external article (position 4; position 9 for 'hrv by age'); the only selected page written by an HRV-analytics specialist with a reference list (Nunan 2010, Task Force 1996, Autonomic Aging dataset); covers normal RMSSD range, by-age and by-sex charts, sleep HRV and 'dangerously low' FAQ. DR 53, est. 8,491 monthly traffic.

pages.title: What Is a Good HRV? Charts of Normal HRV by Age (Different Health)
pages.reason: Third-highest external article (position 6; position 2 for 'hrv by age', where it leads the organic set and is cited by the AI Overview); the only page with a full numeric by-age, by-sex RMSSD table traced to a primary dataset (Lifelines, Tegegne 2020) and an explicit device-comparability section. DR 21, est. 5,373 monthly traffic.
